==Usage instructions==
This award is to be distributed as an end-of-the-year celebration of a WookieeProject's success. 

===Required parameters===
*|WP = Any shorthand for a particular WookieeProject that is listed as a shortcut [[User:JocastaBot/Project_Data|here]].
*|award = The specific feat being acknowledged.
*|year = The year the feat was accomplished.
